name: evolving-skills
description: Skills for creating and evolving learning-enabled agent skills over time.

interface.shortDescription: Create skills that learn, then evolve them without breaking their behavior.
interface.longDescription: Evolving Skills ships with two skills that work together: the full Create Skill package for generating learning-enabled skills with clear routing and capture patterns, and Evolve for promoting accumulated learnings into the right skill surface before clearing the learning backlog.
defaultPrompt: Create a learning-enabled skill for repo triage.
Evolve my sales-email skill from its learnings.
Add learnings capture to an existing skill.
